title: The Tug of War Within: Mitigating the Fairness-Privacy Conflicts in Large Language Models

findings.finding: Supervised fine-tuning aimed at raising an LLM's privacy awareness measurably degrades its fairness awareness. On Salad-bench 'privacy infringement' and 'unfair representation' query sets scored by MD-judge, full fine-tuning moved Qwen2-7B-Instruct from 0.6684 fairness / 0.7412 privacy to 0.5418 / 0.7900, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 from 0.6231 / 0.6636 to 0.5570 / 0.7793, and Vicuna-7B-v1.5 from 0.5501 / 0.3760 to 0.4046 / 0.5297; LoRA, DoRA and ReFT show the same pattern. Llama2-7B-Chat instead declined on both axes under SFT (fairness 0.7386 to 0.5478, privacy 0.7504 to 0.6758), so the privacy-up/fairness-down trade-off is demonstrated on three model families, not four. The effect persists even when an equal amount of fairness-awareness data is added to the fine-tuning set.
findings.finding_quote: Recalling the results in Figure 1(b), employing SFTs method to enhance the LLM’s awareness of privacy leads to a significant decrease in model’s fairness awareness.

findings.finding: The authors' training-free intervention SPIN, which suppresses neurons jointly encoding fairness and privacy, raises both awareness scores at once on all four model families, e.g. Qwen2-7B-Instruct fairness 0.6684 to 0.7497 (+12.2% relative) and privacy 0.7412 to 0.8447 (+14.0% relative), Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 0.6231 to 0.6342 / 0.6636 to 0.7154, Vicuna-7B-v1.5 0.5501 to 0.5778 / 0.3760 to 0.4414 and Llama2-7B-Chat 0.7386 to 0.7746 / 0.7504 to 0.8432, while leaving general capability essentially unchanged across nine benchmarks (HellaSwag, Race, MMLU, GPQA, OpenBookQA, BoolQ, AG News, IMDB, Perplexity); it also remains effective with only a few hundred samples and even when only malicious fine-tuning data is available.
findings.finding_quote: SPIN enhances LLM’s awareness of fairness and privacy simultaneously.
